create_Docker_runtime: create a Docker runtime instance with an image or dockerfile for containerized process execution
run_Launcher_container: run a Docker container with environment variables, volume mounts, and host network mode via the Launcher class
build_Docker_image_from_dockerfile: build a Docker image from a dockerfile with optional caching and verbose output using the Docker class
pipe_Docker_stdout_stdin: pipe stdout and stdin between a Docker container and an async message publisher using websocket I/O
handle_Docker_container_lifecycle: handle Docker container lifecycle events including start, stop, wait, and cleanup with state tracking
